TEDDY demo

Source: DEMO.md

This directory provides a minimal demo dataset for quickly testing the core TEDDY workflow.

Contents

  • data/: a small mm10/GRCm38 demo dataset (chr8 subset), including:
    • reference GTF
    • TE annotation
    • two RNA-seq BAM files
  • run_demo.R: runs the complete short-read TEDDY workflow on the demo dataset.
  • output/: expected output generated by run_demo.R.

Usage

From the TEDDY repository root, run:

Rscript demo/run_demo.R

The script reproduces the expected demo output in demo/output.

For a complete description of all functions, parameters, and advanced workflows (including long-read and cross-platform analyses), please refer to the TEDDY tutorial and package vignettes.
